author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Burnout Revenge | PCSX2 vs Xemu vs Xenia Comparison | PS2 / Xbox / Xbox 360
summary: N-tertainment X-tended places Burnout Revenge side by side through PCSX2, Xemu and Xenia, using the PS2, original Xbox and Xbox 360 releases to expose platform-specific presentation rather than declaring one emulator universally superior.

blocks.text: Burnout Revenge is a useful cross-platform subject because its Xbox 360 release is not simply the same output resolution as the PS2 edition. The comparison aligns footage from three emulators representing three console targets, letting viewers inspect geometry, lighting, effects, color, interface treatment and performance presentation. Keeping one game family in view reduces the genre and art-direction noise found in unrelated showcase reels. It also illustrates that emulator comparisons frequently inherit differences from the original ports before host settings enter the picture.

The description does not record game region, emulator versions, renderer backends, internal resolutions, save location or capture synchronization. Without those controls, a visible difference cannot be assigned confidently to hardware, port revision, emulator accuracy or user configuration. Side-by-side YouTube encoding can further hide frame pacing and fine effects. Treat the clip as a catalogue of questions: choose one matched event or track, identify the retail differences first, then reproduce it with documented builds and output settings before using the footage as compatibility evidence.
